source.note: Full text of ASME BPVC Section II, Part A (Ferrous Material Specifications), Volume 2 — SA-1010/SA-1010M - Specification for Higher-Strength Martensitic Stainless Steel Plate, Sheet, and Strip — as supplied by Daniel Velasquez on 2026-09-07 and extracted from the supplied PDF with marker-pdf. `data` is the extractor's output verbatim — the drop's own `document`, `part`, `figures` and `pages` blocks, with the page-by-page block tree, its HTML, tables and layout coordinates unedited. This file IS the source document, so `transcribed_from` names its own path: it is the artefact under review, not a transcription of one. The volume was supplied as one combined PDF and cut into parts at its own headings, so this file is a page-range slice of a single extraction and its page ids (PDF pages None–None, no printed page numbers on these pages) are the combined document's own, not renumbered from 0. Front matter (cover and title page, contents, list of sections, foreword, statement of policy, personnel, correspondence, summary of changes, cross-referencing) and back matter (back cover) were deleted from the drop before supply and are NOT filed; the drop's `content.json`, `index.json`, `meta.json` and `README.md` are retained beside the kind folders, unfiled, for the same reason. The edition — 2025 Edition (ASME BPVC.II.A-2025), issued 2025-07-01 — is stated on the title page, which this drop no longer carries as a filed cut: it survives only inside the retained `content.json`, so no filed cut of this standard prints its own edition. This cut carries no figure.

children.html: SPECIFICATION FOR HIGHER-STRENGTH MARTENSITIC STAINLESS STEEL PLATE, SHEET, AND STRIP
(Identical with ASTM Specification A1010/A1010M-01(2009) except for an editorial correction to a column heading in Table 2.)
SPECIFICATION FOR HIGHER-STRENGTH MARTENSITIC STAINLESS STEEL PLATE, SHEET, AND STRIP
[Identical with ASTM Specification A 1010/A1010M-01(2009) except for an editorial correction to a column heading in Table 2.]

1.1 This specification covers martensitic stainless steels for various structural, architectural, pressure vessel, and heat-resisting applications. The mechanical properties of these steels are customarily, but not necessarily, developed by a suitable heat treatment generally referred to as tempering.
1.2 Steel products under this specification are available in two grades:

1.3 The maximum thickness of plates is limited only by the capacity of the composition to meet the specified mechanical property requirements; however, current practice normally limits the maximum thickness of plates furnished under this specification to 1 in. [25 mm].

1.4 The values stated in inch-pound or SI units are to be regarded separately as the standard. Within the text, SI units are shown in brackets. The values stated in each system are not exact equivalents; therefore, each system must be used independently of the other. Combining values from the two systems may result in nonconformance with the specification. The inch-pound units shall apply unless the "M" designation of this specification is specified in the purchase order.

A 673/A 673M Specification for Sampling Procedure for Impact Testing of Structural Steel E 527 Practice for Numbering Metals and Alloys (UNS)
2.2 Other Document: SAE J 1086 Recommended Practice for Numbering Metals and Alloys

3.1.4 Heat Analysis, 3.1.5 Product Analysis, 3.1.6 Finish for Sheet,

3.1.18 Material Test Report and Certification.

Supplementary requirements shall not apply unless specified on the purchase order. Requirements other than those shown in this section may be specified subject to agreement between the supplier and the purchaser. The following supplementary requirements are suitable for use with this specification.
S1.1 Charpy V-notch impact tests shall be conducted in accordance with Specification A 673/A 673M.
